tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Prepare Shop/UCP checkout only when asked. No separate spend request is needed. Use exact variant IDs/quantities. Share continue_url unchanged for Review and pay, including requires_escalation. Never recreate: get/update its ID. Address incomplete via update. Complete ready_for_complete only after buyer approval. Creates no order.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Read with the same shop/exact opaque ID before update/completion or after an uncertain write. continue_url is Review and pay, not a product page/purchase proof.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Replace full checkout, not patch/payment. Read first; change only authorized fields; retain all other request fields, including empty objects/arrays. Response-only fields drop. Same shop/exact ID; check status/messages/continue_url. After uncertainty, read before retry.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Send user-approved payment to the same shop/exact checkout ID with one exact offered instrument selected:true. Only completed + order proves purchase. After uncertainty, read get_checkout; never repeat completion or start a replacement purchase.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create a cart only when asked to save items; interest is not permission. Use exact returned variant IDs/quantities. Use create_checkout for Review and pay. Does not order.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read with the same shop/exact opaque ID before update or after an uncertain cart write.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Replace full cart, not a patch. Read first; change only authorized fields; retain all other request fields, including empty objects/arrays. Response-only fields drop. Same shop/exact ID; check returned state. After uncertainty, read before retry.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find by query/like. Anonymous works; sign-in adds saved preferences. Context soft; filters hard. Matches/options do not prove the variant. Check messages; ground options, availability, price/currency, rating, seller, and URL in the exact offer. Use get_product only for unresolved facts/options. Amounts are minor units.

d2.description: ISO 4217 minor units: USD2, JPY0, KWD3.
d2.title: Amount

location.description: Opaque merchant location ID, not locality.

payment.description: Advertised handlers, most preferred first; ignore unknowns.

types.description: Instrument types, most preferred first; ignore unknowns.

signals.description: Observed/verified platform facts; no buyer claims.
signals.title: Signals

catalog_id.description: Saved catalog ID whose configuration constrains search.

filters.description: Hard requirements; fields AND, stated lists OR. Check messages/every offer.

attributes.description: Attributes AND; each value list OR. Check ignored-name messages.

name.description: Supported names: Color, Size, Target gender.

available.description: true/omitted: sale-ready only; false: include unavailable.

price_tier.description: OR category-relative tiers, not a budget cap; check ignored-value messages.

variant.description: At least one variant must meet these thresholds.

ships_to.description: Hard destination; context may supply it if omitted; matching context may refine estimates.

shops.description: OR seller.id Shop GIDs/domains; check unmatched messages.

like.description: One product/variant ID or image reference for similarity. Add query to refine an image reference. Put hard requirements in supported filters.

id.description: Exact Shopify product or variant GID.

content_type.description: Image MIME type, e.g. image/jpeg or image/webp.

cursor.description: Pass unchanged with the same query, like, context, and filters.

query.description: Preserve intent; clarify only. Add no preferences/popularity. Put hard requirements in supported filters.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Resolve known product/variant IDs, GTINs, UPCs, or URLs. Use search_catalog for discovery; get_product only for unresolved options/details. Preserve IDs/URLs; ground claims in the exact offer. Amounts are minor units.

d1.title: Amount

location.description: Opaque merchant location ID, not locality.

payment.description: Advertised handlers, most preferred first; ignore unknowns.

types.description: Instrument types, most preferred first; ignore unknowns.

signals.description: Observed/verified platform facts; no buyer claims.
signals.title: Signals

filters.description: Hard requirements; fields AND, stated lists OR. Verify the offer.

available.description: true/omitted: sale-ready only; false: include unavailable.

ships_to.description: Hard destination; context may supply it if omitted; matching context may refine estimates.

shops.description: OR seller.id Shop GIDs/domains; check unmatched messages.

ids.description: Up to 50 exact IDs/URLs; preserve returned values.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Resolve missing details/options for a known product. Use its returned ID/exact option name-label pairs; verify effective selection because requests may drop. Ground availability, seller, price/currency, rating, and URL in the exact offer. Skip if prior results prove facts. Amounts are minor units.

payment.description: Advertised handlers, most preferred first; ignore unknowns.

types.description: Instrument types, most preferred first; ignore unknowns.

preferences.description: Ordered option names, relaxed from the end; not hard requirements.

available.description: true/omitted: sale-ready only; false: include unavailable.

ships_to.description: Hard destination; context may supply it if omitted; matching context may refine estimates.

shops.description: OR seller.id Shop GIDs/domains; check unmatched messages.

id.description: Exact returned product ID; resolve URL/variant via lookup_catalog first.

selected.description: Exact returned name/label pairs; verify effective selection because requests may drop.

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Search signed-in buyer's Shop-tracked orders/standalone shipments. Omit query for recent. Missing is unknown. events[].type is fulfillment; use status/carrier tracking for progress. LABEL_CREATED proves only a label. Email-detected records may omit money/tracking/links. Page only as needed.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read signed-in Shop account, addresses, budget/cards. For missing checkout delivery, copy one addresses[] entry unchanged into fulfillment destinations and select its id; preferred_address_id is default. buyer.email is display-only, never checkout input. Missing is unknown; empty payment.instruments means no visible budget.

tools.name: create_spend_request
tools.description: Request buyer approval for a purchase where the agent enters a payment credential into a website's checkout form using a browser. Provide the purchase terms and spending limit; name a saved card, or omit it to use the account's preferred card. Share the returned continue_url unchanged for review and approval. This does not pay or place an order.

tools.name: get_spend_request
tools.description: Check the spend request's status. After buyer approval, returns the payment credential. Use it unchanged and only for the approved purchase.

tools.name: update_spend_request
tools.description: Update the request's address, items, totals or spending limit. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Wallet decides whether its current state allows the update.

tools.name: cancel_spend_request
tools.description: Cancel the spend request; this does not cancel/refund the purchase or revoke an issued credential.

tools.name: complete_spend_request
tools.description: Report the purchase attempt's outcome as success or error. Include order details when available, or failure information for an error. This records your report, not payment confirmation.
